# mistershell_ai_guardrail (Resource)

Manages an AI command allowlist toggle for one registered resource type. Destroy restores the setting captured at adoption or import.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_ai_guardrail" "ssh" {
  resource_type     = "generic_ssh"
  allowlist_enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allowlist_enabled` (Boolean)
- `resource_type` (String)

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `original_allowlist_enabled` (Boolean) Setting captured at adoption/import and restored on destroy.

## Ownership and restoration

The resource manages one registered `resource_type`. Disabling its allowlist
changes the commands AI may propose for injection. Adoption captures the current
toggle in `original_allowlist_enabled`. Destroy restores that captured setting:
a pre-existing disabled guardrail remains disabled after Terraform releases it.
An originally enabled guardrail is restored using the dedicated reset endpoint.

Import captures the current setting as the restoration baseline; it cannot
recover a setting from before import. Keep one resource per resource type and
retain its state until restoration completes. For existing state that lacks a
baseline, the first refresh captures the then-current setting.

## Import

```shell
terraform import mistershell_ai_guardrail.example generic_ssh
```
